Flags are rematerialized using the single canonical CMP rule; no copied flag or ISA semantics is introduced and every allowed native XOR AF choice is covered.
Both first/second context-read fault boundaries reconstruct full native state from actual B state plus unchanged invocation fields; second-load fault uses actual B data value for native RCX.
Actual byte-decoded native relational first-block execution and actual B29 execution retain identical ordered read/fault effects, with no selected native successor or architectural endpoint premise.
The +8 LEA/CMP/JA block preserves the full first-block architectural relation and reconstructs every native field from actual B r0/r1/r2/r3 and the immutable invocation frame.

Every canonical decoded relational +8 block has exactly that reconstructed state and empty effects/fault, with either actual successor and modular64bit addition; no branch outcome or next-state premise is supplied.
The +72 ADD/CMP/JA block preserves every native architectural field under its reconstructed view; both native/B additions wrap64bits with the same real successor.

Native RDI retains the earlier +8 value after B overwrites r3; reconstruction derives it from B r2 plus8. The required prior temporary invariant is proved from the actual preceding B ADD, not a new program check or pointer restriction.
The universal decoded native +72 block has that complete state and empty effects/fault; flags reuse the exact canonical ADD/CMP stages, not a copied ISA semantics.
Successful store result and all four first-store faults preserve the complete native architecture, exact partial memory, ordered effects and fault, for every memory-permission assignment.

The prior +72 temporary invariant is derived from the actual B ADD. All changed GPRs and flags, including native values no longer live in B, remain represented by actual B values, canonical operations and immutable entry/real-load snapshots.
JA/EXIT at BPC27/28/29 preserve the corresponding payload-end architecture in every guard-exit/store view; all previous state audits recheck against the extended exit mapping.
